steps_heading: Three steps, zero trips to a shop.

steps.title: Text a photo
steps.text: Snap the dent in good light and text it to 682-308-6636. You'll get a price back, usually the same day.

steps.title: He comes to you
steps.text: Pick a time. Cannon brings the tools and light board to your driveway or workplace anywhere in DFW.

steps.title: Dent's gone
steps.text: Most single dents take an hour or two. The repair is permanent and the dent won't come back.
